name: beeper-mcp-addon
description: Files, new chats, catching up, reactions and edits for Beeper's MCP.
long_description: Unofficial companion to Beeper Desktop's built-in MCP server. Adds download_attachment (one file, or every photo and video of a chat over a period), send_file (with automatic video conversion when ffmpeg is installed), search_contacts, start_chat, delete_message, wait_for_message, get_new_messages (catch up on many chats in one compact call), get_reactions, react and edit_message on top of the local Beeper Client API. On first use it opens Beeper so you can approve access; the token is kept in your system keychain.

tools.name: download_attachment
tools.description: Save a message attachment, or all photos and videos of a chat over a period, to disk

tools.name: send_file
tools.description: Send a local file to a chat

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Find people on an account, including new contacts

tools.name: start_chat
tools.description: Open a direct chat with someone and return its chatID

tools.name: wait_for_message
tools.description: Wait for an incoming message (e.g. a reply) instead of polling

tools.name: get_new_messages
tools.description: Catch up on everything new since a given time, across chats, in one compact call

tools.name: get_reactions
tools.description: See who reacted to a message, by name

tools.name: react
tools.description: Add or remove an emoji reaction

tools.name: edit_message
tools.description: Change the text of a message you sent

beeper_token.title: Beeper access token (optional)
beeper_token.description: Leave empty: on first use, Beeper opens and asks you to approve access. Or paste a token from Beeper Desktop > Settings > Developers.
